"Still in Love with You" is a country song by **Brooks & Dunn**, the American country music duo consisting of Kix Brooks and Ronnie Dunn. Here are the key details about the song:

## Song Information

- **Album:** The song appeared on their debut album **"Brand New Man"** (1991), though some sources also associate it with their 1993 album "Hard Workin' Man"
- **Songwriters:** Don Cook, Kix Brooks, and Ronnie Dunn
- **Theme:** The song tells the story of a man leaving his lover, trying to find ways to get over her—whether by riding off on a horse, flying away, or dreaming—but ultimately accepting that he'd "wake up still in love with you"

## Notable Lyrics

> "My taxicab is waiting / Wish I could hold you one last time"
>
> "If I had a horse I'd ride off in the sunset / If I had wings I'd fly off in the sky so blue / If I had the time I'd spend my whole life dreaming / But I'd wake up still in love with you"

The song showcases the classic Brooks & Dunn sound that helped define 1990s country music, with its blend of traditional country storytelling and energetic delivery.
